scope: Synthetic streaming measurements only; not real WGS. See recorded thread budget and CPU affinity.

environment.thread_scope: Compute worker counts; no physical-core simulation or CPU affinity applied.

cpu.stderr: sysctl: sysctl fmt -1 1024 1: Operation not permitted

timing_policy: One excluded warmup then alternating AB/BA pairs. Serial subprocesses; hashes, preparation, comparisons outside timings. Cache loading stays timed. No OS page-cache clearing.
output_policy: Exact VCF/JSON bytes and BAM header/full-record-byte multiset, preserving duplicate multiplicity; only BAM record order ignored.

user_ram_exception.scope: The user accepted the approximately 8 MiB increase in near10 measured pair 3. The original failed gate is retained; this is not a general relaxation for unmeasured workloads.
user_ram_exception.cause: Undetermined; no queue high-water or time-series RSS telemetry was collected.
